'''2004 World Championship Day 2 Brad Reinhold DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brad Reinhold]] at [[2004 World Championship]] (Day 2); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Brad "Admiral Twk" Reinhold (2004-09-01).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33609 Alter is money]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050525170540/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33609&PHPSESSID=...328fedb22570524062aeb1303 Internet Archive]</ref>
